title: Overdraft-safe ledger
description: An account starts with an opening balance and receives a list of moves: positive numbers are deposits, negative numbers are withdrawals, zero changes nothing. If the opening balance is negative, return the error `negative opening balance` and print nothing at all. Otherwise process the moves in order, numbering them from 1. A move that would take the balance below zero is refused: print `move N rejected: AMOUNT` (AMOUNT with its sign, as given) and leave the balance as it was. Any other move is applied: print `move N ok: balance B` with the new balance. After the last move print `final: B` and return the closing balance as a success value. The balance never becomes negative; a balance of exactly zero is allowed.

visible_examples.stdout:
move 1 ok: balance 150
move 2 rejected: -200
final: 150

notes: Level 3. Invariant balance >= 0 across steps; refused moves do not change state; error path prints nothing; withdrawal to exactly 0 is accepted; ok and err JSON encodings.
